If you're passionate about game development, eager to showcase and improve your skills on major titles, and if you are open to potential partnerships down the line, we encourage you to apply and become part of our expert talent community. We look forward to connecting with you!

As a UI (User Interface) Artist, you will be responsible for creating visually appealing and intuitive user interfaces for mobile games and apps. You will collaborate closely with game designers, artists, and developers to design, implement, and optimize UI elements that enhance the overall gameplay experience and engage players.

The purpose of the role is to conceptualize, mock-up, and execute interface designs across many different systems, creating a visual and functional connection between the user experience and the game story. You will work with us to design and develop user interface styles, structures and flows integrated in our projects, augmenting gameplay systems and complementing the established art direction.

Here's what you can expect:

Profile Preselection: Our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile to ensure it aligns with our requirements and values

Talent Acquisition Interview: Selected candidates will undergo an initial interview to discuss about their experience, skills, and fit for the role.

Online Test: Qualified candidates will be invited to complete an online assessment to demonstrate their abilities.

Technical Interview: Finalists will participate in a technical interview to assess their proficiency and compatibility with our team when a project staffing plan is made.

We're committed to finding the best talent to join our growing team, and we look forward to connecting with you throughout this exciting process.

The Quest:

UI Design: Create concept sketches, wireframes, and mockups for various UI screens, including menus, HUDs (Heads-Up Displays), overlays, and interactive elements. Develop cohesive visual themes and styles that align with the game's aesthetic and target audience.

Graphic Asset Creation: Design and produce high-quality UI assets, including icons, buttons, backgrounds, and visual effects. Utilize graphic design software (e.g., Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator) to create scalable and visually appealing UI elements that enhance usability and accessibility.

Iconography and Typography: Select appropriate icons, symbols, and typography to convey information, enhance navigation, and communicate game mechanics effectively. Ensure consistency in iconography style, color schemes, and typography across all UI screens.

Animation and Motion Graphics: Implement animations and motion graphics to enhance interactivity, feedback, and visual interest within the UI. Create dynamic transitions, button animations, and visual effects that respond to player interactions and events.

User Experience (UX) Optimization: Conduct user research, playtesting, and usability testing to gather feedback and insights on UI design and functionality. Iterate on UI layouts, navigation flows, and interactive elements to improve user engagement, retention, and satisfaction.

Technical Implementation: Work closely with developers to integrate UI assets into the game engine (e.g., Unity, Unreal Engine) and ensure optimal performance across various mobile devices and screen resolutions. Collaborate on UI scripting and implementation tasks as needed.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with game designers, artists, programmers, and producers to align UI design goals with gameplay mechanics, narrative elements, and technical constraints. Participate in brainstorming sessions and provide creative input to enhance the overall game experience.

Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough testing and quality assurance checks to ensure that UI elements function as intended, adhere to design specifications, and meet performance targets. Identify and address any UI-related bugs, glitches, or usability issues in a timely manner.

The Skills:

Strong understanding of design principles, color theory, typography, and composition. Ability to create visually appealing and cohesive UI designs that enhance usability and aesthetics.

Ability to bring static UI elements to life through dynamic animations and visual effects. Experience with animation software (e.g., Adobe After Effects, Spine) and a passion for creating engaging animations and motion graphics within UI interfaces.

User-Centered Design, knowledge of user experience (UX) principles and methodologies, including user research, usability testing, and iterative design. Ability to empathize with users and advocate for their needs throughout the UI design process.

Strong foundation on the best practices for designing UI interfaces for touchscreen devices. Experience with mobile game engines (e.g., Unity, Unreal Engine) is a plus. Experience with the mobile gaming industry, platform-specific UI/UX guidelines.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively convey ideas, concepts, and feedback to cross-functional team members. Comfortable giving and receiving constructive criticism in a team-oriented environment.

Creative thinking skills and a passion for pushing the boundaries of UI design in mobile games. Ability to solve design challenges, iterate on ideas, and adapt to feedback and changing project requirements.

description:
Sobre a Lemon
As mudanças climáticas são um desafio complexo, mas as soluções não podem ser. Enquanto as ações climáticas forem de difícil acesso, nunca teremos um impacto unificado grande o bastante para fazer a diferença no planeta.

Sobre a Lemon
As mudanças climáticas são um desafio complexo, mas as soluções não podem ser. Enquanto as ações climáticas forem de difícil acesso, nunca teremos um impacto unificado grande o bastante para fazer a diferença no planeta.
A Lemon é o jeito mais simples para empresas e pessoas impactarem positivamente o meio ambiente por meio de uma energia mais barata e limpa. Entregamos uma energia diferente da tradicional, por isso conseguimos oferecer uma conta de luz mais econômica e sustentável. Somos comprometidos com nossos clientes e com o planeta, por isso garantimos sempre um atendimento mais próximo e inovações que incentivam mudanças no setor elétrico.
Somos apoiados pelos principais investidores em tecnologia de todo o mundo, incluindo fundos de venture capital como Kaszek, Lowercarbon Capital, Canary, Big Bets e Actyus. Endereçar um dos desafios mais significativos do mundo requer pensamento inovador e perspectivas diversas. Estamos construindo um time de pessoas com diferentes experiências, repertório profissional e formações educacionais. Se você compartilha da nossa paixão de criar essa a nova era da energia limpa, estamos ansiosos para conhecer o que de único você traz para Lemon.
Saiba mais sobre a Lemon
Sobre o time de tech:
O time de Tecnologia da Lemon é o coração da nossa inovação e crescimento. Nossa tecnologia é criada e mantida por times multidisciplinares e somos responsáveis por desenvolver soluções escaláveis e eficientes que impulsionam a nossa missão de revolucionar o setor de energia limpa. Trabalhamos em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, onde a criatividade e a excelência técnica são valorizadas. No nosso backend usamos principalmente aws com node.js e microsserviços orientados a eventos assíncronos. Nosso principal banco de dados é o DynamoDB. Toda a nossa infra é serverless e criada como código. Usamos jest e github actions para nossos testes e deploys. Saiba mais sobre a nossa stack aqui.
Se você deseja fazer parte de uma equipe que está na vanguarda da tecnologia e contribuir para um futuro mais sustentável, a Lemon é o lugar certo para você.
O Que Você Vai Fazer:

  • Ter a chance real de participar da formação de uma empresa unicórnio;
  • Fazer a diferença em uma empresa que tem um dos maiores potenciais do mercado brasileiro atualmente;
  • Conseguir aplicar soluções tecnológicas que impactam positivamente o meio onde vivemos;
  • Liderar a direção técnica do time, garantindo a aplicação das melhores práticas e padrões de qualidade;
  • Representar o time de engenharia em discussões estratégicas e processos de tomada de decisão;
  • Supervisionar a arquitetura e o design de sistemas complexos, assegurando escalabilidade, estabilidade e custos;
  • Ser responsável pela formação e times de alta performance na área de tecnologia.
O perfil que buscamos:
  • Pró-atividade para resolver desafios complexos e muita vontade de fazer acontecer, passividade não faz parte deste perfil;
  • Capacidade de inspirar e motivar o time, direcionando-o para a excelência e inovação;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, com capacidade de articular conceitos técnicos para partes interessadas não técnicas;
  • Mentalidade de ownership: responsabilidade pelo que constrói e mantém;
  • Flexibilidade para trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico e de mudanças frequentes (somos uma startup);
  • Conexão com o impacto de negócio e entendimento do porquê por trás das soluções;
  • Comunicação clara, respeitosa e madura, com abertura para dar e receber feedback;
  • Empatia para trabalhar bem com pessoas de diferentes áreas e perfis;
  • Compromisso com o próprio desenvolvimento contínuo.
Experiência prévia / habilidades exigidas:
  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Mínimo de 2 anos atuando como líder ténico;
  • Mínimo de 2 anos de Experiência em gestão de pessoas e desenvolvimento de equipes de tecnologia;
  • Experiência comprovada na entrega de projetos de larga escala e alto impacto;
  • Forte compreensão dos princípios de desenvolvimento de software, incluindo DDD, microservices e arquiteturas baseadas em cloud;
  • Habilidade para equilibrar excelência técnica com pragmatismo e entrega de valor ao negócio.
Será um diferencial se você já tiver conhecimentos em (Não esperamos que você já conheça tudo isso, procuramos pessoas curiosas e que estejam dispostas a aprender):
  • Experiência no setor de energia e/ou em startups de rápido crescimento;
  • Conhecimento em Node.js e React;
  • Familiaridade com tecnologias de cloud computing, especialmente AWS;
  • Compreensão de desafios regulatórios e de compliance em setores regulados.

title: Business Services Team Manager
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few roles based in offices.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring a Business Services Team Manager to lead efficient and effective travel, logistics, event, scheduling, expense policy and administration.

This executive role requires outstanding coordination, planning, decision-making, budgeting, procurement, reporting and management. It is a fast-paced and complex operation in the tech industry.

We coordinate large-scale company events which involve travel for hundreds of people from 80+ countries. We run such events four times a year, a significant investment in our ability to shape culture, teamwork, execution plans and strategy. Our team is responsible for travel procurement and logistics, ensuring that these events run efficiently and safely. Visas, travel complications and unexpected situations make this a complex operation to run efficiently, demanding a rigorous approach and high work ethic in the team.

This team also serves as an independent check on expense claim approval, ensuring fairness and consistency across teams and countries. This requires integrity, transparency and accountability, and a willingness to set and politely defend the same expectations of the most senior and most junior colleagues.

Together these responsibilities amount to tens of millions in operational costs and a significant number of tactical and operational decisions.

Our team also provides traditional 'EA' services for company leads, though they do this across departments and as a consistent service rather than as personal assistants; they schedule meetings, coordinate monthly reports, handle delegated approvals for travel and expenses, work across teams, coordinate with suppliers, and run small projects or initiatives.

Location: Worldwide, home based, except in locations where we have an office, such as London, Taipei and Beijing

Leadership and accountability

This team has a direct impact on every team at Canonical. It is important for them to have excellent judgment and interpersonal skills, the confidence to hold people accountable and defend positions of policy, and the work ethic to move quickly through a large volume of work. It is also essential that the team participate in every company event, from the planning and venue selection stages to scheduling, operations and safety reviews, to ensure that they establish personal relationships with team leaders and can ensure that these events run smoothly.

As a manager, your team would be responsible for

  • Travel approvals, logistics and operations
  • Expense review in line with policies
  • Planning of complex company events four times a year
  • Company offices that provide executive briefing and operational facilities
  • Our global duty of care, health and safety programs with comprehensive policies and practices

What we are looking for

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • An undergraduate degree in a technical or business subject
  • Drive, and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Leadership and management skills
  • Demonstrable good judgement in matters involving money, policy and in-person interactions
  • Ability to work in a global, multicultural organisation
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility
  • Responsibility, accountability, thoughtfulness and self-awareness
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel up to four times a year, for company events up to two weeks long

Additional skills that you might also bring

  • Travel industry experience
  • Project management experience
  • Event management and operations experience
  • Business and corporate administration experience

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer.

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Job Description
A Nova Escola tem a missão de fortalecer os educadores para transformar a educação pública brasileira e possibilitar que os alunos desenvolvam o máximo do seu potencial.
A Nova Escola é um negócio social de Educação e a marca mais reconhecida por professores de Educação Básica no Brasil.
Nossa missão é fortalecer educadores para transformar a Educação pública brasileira e possibilitar que os alunos desenvolvam o máximo do seu potencial.
Desenvolvemos produtos, serviços e conteúdos que valorizam os professores, facilitam seu dia-a-dia e apoiam sua carreira. Nosso principal mantenedor é a Fundação Lemann e realizamos parcerias com diversas organizações como Google.org, Facebook, Fundação Itaú Social, Imaginable Futures, Governo Britânico, secretarias de educação e outras organizações que nos ajudam nesse desafio.
64% dos professores brasileiros utilizam nossos planos de aula todos os meses, além disso temos 3 milhões de visitantes únicos por mês em nossa plataforma e cerca de 1,8 milhões de seguidores em nossas redes sociais, o que nos permite conhecer bem nosso público.
Valorizamos a diversidade no ambiente de trabalho e estamos buscando tornar a Nova Escola ainda mais diversa. As nossas vagas são destinadas a todos!
Responsibilities and assignments
Criamos o Banco de Talentos da Nova Escola para que profissionais que tenham o desejo de transformar a educação junto com a gente, possam demonstrar o seu interesse em fazer parte do nosso nosso negócio.
Caso não tenha encontrado nenhuma vaga de acordo com seu perfil, deixe seu currículo cadastrado em neste Banco de Talentos, acompanhe as divulgações e mantenha seus dados profissionais atualizados, pois quando tivermos uma vaga que faça sentido para o seu perfil, poderemos entrar em contato!
Desde já agradecemos seu interesse em fazer parte do nosso time!
Additional information
O que oferecemos

  • Contratação CLT com flexibilidade de horário
  • Participação nos Resultados da Empresa (até 2 salários nominais)
  • Plano de Saúde Amil (apartamento) 90% para funcionários + 50% para dependentes
  • Licença estendida de maternidade e paternidade
  • Vale Refeição - Sodexo
  • Auxílio creche (até 7 anos)
  • Aulas de Inglês (na empresa)
  • Recesso de fim de ano (10 dias de folga)
Devido a pandemia do COVID-19, atualmente estamos trabalhando em modelo de home office. Esperamos em breve voltar para nosso escritório, no bairro de Pinheiros, em São Paulo, quando tudo estiver seguro para esta volta. Nosso escritório se encontra em uma região de fácil acesso (metrô e ônibus) e também com várias opções de restaurantes, lazer e esporte.
Faça parte do time que está transformando a Educação pública do país!
Conheça a Nova Escola
A Nova Escola é um negócio social de Educação e a marca mais reconhecida por professores de Educação Básica no Brasil
Nossa missão é fortalecer educadores para transformar a Educação pública brasileira e possibilitar que os alunos desenvolvam o máximo do seu potencial.

Valorizamos a diversidade no ambiente de trabalho e estamos buscando tornar a Nova Escola ainda mais diversa. As nossas vagas são destinadas a todos!
Trabalhamos com
O Educador no centro: Para nós, a transformação acontece através das professoras e professores de escola pública. Sentimos orgulho das nossas soluções serem baseadas em dados e evidências, desenvolvidas a partir e junto daqueles que vivenciam diariamente a realidade da educação pública brasileira. Estamos unidos com os professores por uma causa comum: oferecer um ensino de qualidade para todos os alunos do nosso país.
Autonomia para ir além: Somos inquietos, dispostos a arriscar, dialogar e reinventar. Criamos novos formatos, melhoramos os existentes, mantendo o foco nos educadores. Assumimos riscos, testamos novas soluções, aprendemos com os erros e medimos nosso impacto. Com essa confiança e autonomia, podemos concentrar nossos esforços no propósito que nos move.
Busca pela Excelência: Nosso time está comprometido a buscar a excelência em tudo que faz para atingir a missão da Nova Escola. Exigimos de nós mesmos um trabalho de qualidade e melhoria contínua. Procuramos, a partir de nossas especialidades, aprender continuamente sobre a Educação Pública.

Acreditamos que pessoas com diferentes trajetórias e pontos de vista se complementam e podem compartilhar um mesmo propósito. Pensamos juntos para pensar maior.
Atitude Responsável: Para nós, agir com responsabilidade é uma prática contínua, tanto no trabalho quanto na vida. Gerenciamos pessoas, parceiros e recursos para desenvolver soluções que geram impacto na educação. Mantemos uma atitude ética, respeitosa, acolhedora e proativa para inspirar uma mudança na sociedade. Nossa atuação é suprapartidária e livre de interesses pessoais na sociedade.
Diálogo transparente: Promovemos um ambiente onde todos se sentem à vontade para fazer perguntas e buscar esclarecimentos abertamente. Incentivamos a comunicação direta e transparente e valorizamos o diálogo produtivo. Acreditamos que a coragem para expressar dúvidas e compartilhar ideias fortalece nossa colaboração e aprimorar nossos processos.

About the Role

At InPlanet, we are pioneering the use of Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) as a scalable carbon removal solution. To ensure the credibility and scientific rigor of our impact, Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) plays a critical role in evaluating the full environmental footprint of our operations—from rock sourcing to CO₂ sequestration.
As our LCA Lead, you will spearhead the development and execution of LCAs for our ongoing and future projects. You will work closely with cross-functional teams—including Science, Operations, Carbon Accounting, and Business Development—to navigate complex sustainability frameworks, structure LCA methodologies for scalability, and produce reliable greenhouse gas (GHG) assessments that feed into our carbon credit issuance process.

title: Program Delivery and Business Development Manager - Dual-Use Robotics
description:
Overview


FLX Solutions is redefining how critical infrastructure is inspected and maintained using advanced robotic systems that enhance mission readiness and safety. Our patented FLX BOT solves one of the toughest challenges in maintenance: reaching the “last meter” in complex environments. It is a modular, collaborative, handheld articulating snake-like robotic platform, and is already in use in the U.S. Navy, Air Force, and shipbuilders with expanding applications in industrial, transit, and construction sectors.


The FLX BOT is 1" in diameter and can navigate confined or hazardous spaces on ships, bases, and aircraft. Its modular design includes interchangeable links with advanced cameras and sensors for obstacle avoidance, and its patented design offers greater articulation, lighter weight, and a smaller footprint than competing robots at a fraction of the cost. Operated by a single technician via handheld control or extension pole, it reduces labor and improves safety.


FLX Solutions has completed and launched pilots with the U.S. Air Force (D2P2 focused on aircraft wing fuel tank inspections at Robins AFB), U.S. Navy (corrosion assessment, 3D tank mapping), and a major DoD Prime. In paid Navy pilots, the FLX BOT reduced inspection times by up to 90% while eliminating the need for teardowns or confined space entry. FLX Solutions has 3 FLX BOTs deployed at the largest shipbuilder for the Navy, and a 1-year pilot with the NYC Metropolitan Transportation Authority (MTA).


The Opportunity: FLX Solutions is at a key inflection point: we have several high-value programs underway and are looking for a proven leader who can secure new contracts and successfully deliver them to completion. Your mission: capitalize on our momentum and scale our success. The FLX BOT technology is already proven and the market is responding. We have a high-confidence pipeline of over $18M including an upcoming large pilot order from the Navy. And this is just the beginning. We are looking for a proven operator to take ownership of critical programs and business development efforts. This is an experienced player role, not a management-only position (yet). While this role has a clear path to building and leading a team as we grow, your initial focus will be on rolling up your sleeves and personally driving. You\'ll work at the intersection of business development, program management, and operations, with the autonomy to take a customer relationship from initial contact to successful program delivery. You will partner directly with the CEO on capture strategy and customer engagement, and with our technical teams to ensure what we sell is what we deliver. The role also involves jumping into whatever business operations tasks are needed to grow the company and complete projects ranging from negotiating a defense contract to refining internal processes, or jumping on a late-night call with a customer in the middle of a trial. We need someone who has been on the startup journey before and helped grow a hardware company from seed stage through commercialization and scale, and has experienced the problems we’re solving first-hand.



What You’ll Do



Business Development and Program Acquisition



  • Identify, pursue, and close new contracts in defense and commercial markets, with an initial focus on high-potential opportunities already in the pipeline

  • Work directly with the CEO on capture strategy, proposal development, and customer engagement

  • Build trusted relationships with decision-makers at government agencies, prime contractors, and industrial partners

  • Lead the proposal and capture process end-to-end: lead the preparation of proposals, RFP responses, and competitive bids from end-to-end: shaping requirements, identifying teaming opportunities, selecting acquisition pathways (BAAs, CSOs, IDIQs, etc.), and submitting winning proposals



Program Leadership and Delivery



  • Serve as the Program Lead for our defense accounts, starting with the execution and multi-site deployment for the U.S. Navy and Air Force programs

  • Act as the primary customer interface for dual-use programs, managing scope, schedule, and budget to ensure all commitments are met

  • Partner with our hardware and software teams to manage technical requirements, identify risks, and guarantee what we sell is what we deliver



Operational Leadership



  • Establish and refine program management processes that can scale with the company

  • Track KPIs for program health, customer satisfaction, and revenue performance

  • Take on diverse business operations tasks that support company growth and program success as an early member of a growing team



Strategic Contribution



  • Work with leadership on market opportunities, partnerships, and program prioritization

  • Represent FLX at customer sites, program reviews, trade shows, conferences, and industry networking events

  • Identify new growth opportunities for business and technology expansion



You Are



  • Experienced in both winning and managing complex programs in defense, aerospace, robotics, and/or other dual-use technology sectors

  • Skilled at working at the intersection of business development, program management, and operations

  • Deeply familiar with DoD procurement processes and effective at building strong customer relationships with government agencies, primes, and dual-use customers

  • Comfortable in a startup environment, able to switch between high-level strategy and hands-on execution

  • Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple high-value projects at the same time

  • Understanding of the business constraints in early stage companies and able to work within them

  • A startup veteran experienced in helping grow startups from seed stage to full commercialization and scaling operations



Qualifications


Required



  • 5-8+ years in program management, business development, or operations in relevant industries

  • Startup or scaling-company experience in hardware or robotics

  • Proven ability to secure and deliver multi-million-dollar programs including DoD acquisition and contracting

  • Established network in Navy, Air Force, shipbuilding, or major industrial maintenance programs

  • U.S. citizenship (due to DoD requirements)

  • Willingness to travel for customer meetings, pilots, and events

  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills

  • Experience and proficiency with modern tools including AI tools, CRMs, and Project Management tools (e.g. ClickUp)



Preferred



  • Firsthand DoD operational experience, particularly as a Veteran of the U.S. Navy or U.S. Air Force (e.g., Engineering Duty Officer)

  • Have led/been involved in the successful fundraising of capital at an early stage dual-use startup

  • Technical background

  • PMP certification or equivalent project management experience



Company Core Values



  • Do what you say, say what you do

  • We all make mistakes; it is what we do afterwards that defines us

  • Treat all with respect. Period.

  • Leave a situation better than you found it

  • Just because something has always been done a certain way, doesn’t mean it has to be done that way in the future



Compensation and Location



  • Salary: Competitive for an early-stage company, with significant performance-based increases tied directly to the programs you deliver and expand

  • Equity: A meaningful, early-stage equity grant. You will be a critical part of our success, and your compensation will reflect that.

  • Location: Remote-friendly. However, we have a strong preference for candidates in a key defense or technology hub (DC area, San Diego, Norfolk, Seattle, Bay Area, NYC) or near our Bethlehem, PA HQ, to enhance collaboration with our team and customers.

  • Flexibility: Will adapt role and package for the right candidate

Nice-to-have skills
  • Strong background in RTOS and real-time performance analysis
  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other low level system engineering

What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. description:
Quartile, the world's largest retail media optimization platform, is a trusted partner for multichannel e-commerce success. Through unmatchedexpertiseand patented AI technology, we fuel growth for 5,300+ brands and sellers worldwide and manage an annual ad spend exceeding$2 billion. Quartile is proud to be an equal opportunity employer with employees stemming from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences. As a business, we value the enrichment that diversity brings to our organization and are committed to a culture that creates a sense of inclusion and belonging. We welcome new perspectives and affirm that all employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, age, familial or marital status, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law.

OVERVIEW:
The Display Strategist is a seasoned, data-driven professional responsible for developing and executing strategic programmatic advertising initiatives within the retail media landscape. This role is essential in designing and scaling high-performance programmatic strategies, creating full-funnel commerce solutions, and delivering measurable results for clients. The Display Strategist will utilize expertise in platforms such as Amazon DSP, The Trade Desk, advanced measurement tools, and the broader retail media ecosystem to deliver innovative solutions aligned with clients' business objectives. As a key partner to clients, internal teams, and retail media platforms, this position plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of programmatic advertising within the organization.
REQUIREMENTS:

  • 4-5 years of experience in programmatic advertising, including 2-3 years managing programmatic retail media (onsite or offsite) across the full campaign life cycle (strategy and activation).
  • 2+ years in a client-facing role, with a preference for experience managing small to medium-sized brands.
  • Strong understanding of Demand Side Platforms (DSPs), including retailer-native (Amazon DSP, Walmart) and non-retailer specific platforms (The Trade Desk, Criteo Commerce Max) for setup and optimization.
  • Proven experience managing a variety of programmatic channels (Display, Video - STV/OTT, Audio, Native, DOOH) and a strategic understanding of deploying these channels to achieve client KPIs.
  • Ability to connect full-funnel marketing efforts (search and display) to retailer-specific sales goals and performance.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities, with a demonstrated capacity for working autonomously.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with a proven track record of presenting and selling ideas clearly to clients and internal teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and thrive under tight deadlines.
  • A strong desire to work in a fast-paced, evolving industry that presents new challenges and opportunities.
  • Strategic thinker with adaptability and the ability to analyze data to identify opportunities and optimize results.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Play a key role within a rapidly growing programmatic advertising team, refining processes and structures to support continued success.
  • Lead the development, execution, and optimization of programmatic display and video campaigns on platforms like Amazon DSP and The Trade Desk.
  • Drive full-funnel commerce strategies for planning and activating programmatic campaigns, collaborating with retail search teams for seamless integration.
  • Utilize Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) to activate custom audiences and implement advanced programmatic strategies.
  • Manage regular client communications to review programmatic performance, discuss business trends, and identify growth opportunities across channels.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve client business performance through innovative, data-driven solutions.
  • Lead programmatic updates during integrated reporting sessions, such as QBRs and annual planning meetings.
  • Guide account strategy development, including budget planning, KPI setting, audience testing, and industry trend analysis.
  • Drive new business development and client expansion opportunities.
  • Leverage reporting, analytics, and competitive analysis tools to refine strategies and achieve measurable results.
  • Contribute to the success of small- and medium-sized client businesses by delivering innovative programmatic solutions in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Provide feedback on product development and user experience based on insights gathered from client interactions and campaign performance.


BENEFITS:

  • Fully remote work
  • The opportunity to join an international team
  • Generous Paid Time Off

title: Criador de Conteúdo e Gerente de Mídias Sociais
description:
Criador de Conteúdo e Gerente de Mídias Sociais

Procuramos uma pessoa criativa, estratégica e orientada a resultados para assumir nossa presença digital como Criador(a) de Conteúdo e Gerente de Mídias Sociais na ALX Recursos Humanos . Essa função é responsável por criar e distribuir conteúdo que aumente a visibilidade da marca, destaque listagens e fechamentos, fortaleça relacionamentos e gere leads através de plataformas como Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube (incluindo Shorts), TikTok, WhatsApp e campanhas de e-mail.

Você será peça central na construção da imagem da corretora e de seus agentes online. A pessoa ideal é tanto contadora de histórias quanto estrategista; capaz de produzir conteúdo envolvente, manter uma rotina de postagens consistente e acompanhar métricas para otimizar os resultados.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e gerenciar um calendário de conteúdo mensal alinhado com os objetivos da marca, cronograma de listagens e sazonalidades.
  • Criar formatos envolventes (Reels, TikToks, Shorts, Stories, depoimentos, bastidores, trechos de blogs, etc.).
  • Escrever legendas persuasivas para posts, destaques de imóveis, atualizações da equipe, resumos de blog e newsletters.
  • Adaptar conteúdo longo (vídeos, eventos, entrevistas) em versões curtas para redes sociais e canais de mensagens.
  • Criar visuais no Canva (ou ferramenta similar) com identidade visual consistente.
  • Produzir ou coordenar peças de marketing como “Novo no Mercado”, “Open House” e “Vendedor”.

Gestão de Redes Sociais

  • Agendar e publicar conteúdo usando ferramentas como Meta Business Suite, Later ou Hootsuite.
  • Monitorar engajamento, responder comentários e mensagens, e cultivar uma comunidade online leal.
  • Acompanhar tendências do setor imobiliário, hashtags, formatos virais e mudanças nos algoritmos.
  • Colaborar com corretores para destacar histórias de sucesso, eventos e marcos.

Campanhas por E-mail e Mensagens Diretas

  • Criar e gerenciar campanhas segmentadas de e-mail via plataformas como Mailchimp ou Flodesk.
  • Utilizar WhatsApp para enviar listas de imóveis, novidades e manter relacionamento com leads, parceiros ou clientes antigos.
  • Manter consistência na mensagem e tom em todos os canais.

Análise, Relatórios e Otimização

  • Acompanhar KPIs como crescimento de seguidores, engajamento, taxas de abertura e cliques, geração de leads e alcance de conteúdo.
  • Sugerir melhorias baseadas em dados e testar variações de conteúdo para melhorar resultados.
  • Realizar testes A/B com diferentes tipos de posts e assuntos de e-mails.

Colaboração e Coordenação

  • Trabalhar próximo à liderança e corretores para alinhar o conteúdo com as metas do negócio.
  • Coordenação com fotógrafos, videomakers e fornecedores externos quando necessário.
  • Oferecer orientações básicas de redes sociais para membros da equipe.

Remuneração e Benefícios

  • Salário base competitivo.
  • Bônus por desempenho com base em engajamento, geração de leads e resultados.
  • Estrutura de trabalho flexível e remota.
  • Oportunidades de crescimento na área de marketing da corretora.
  • Chance de construir um portfólio de marca imobiliária de destaque.

Qualificações

  • Minimo de 2 anos de experiência em criação de conteúdo, mídias sociais ou marketing digital.
  • Excelência na escrita, atenção ao tom de voz e clareza.
  • Habilidade no uso de Canva ou Adobe, edição de vídeo (CapCut, Final Cut, Premiere, InShot, etc.).
  • Domínio de ferramentas de agendamento (Meta Suite, Later, Mailchimp, etc.).
  • Conhecimento sobre geração de leads e nutrição de audiência via conteúdo orgânico.
  • Perfil criativo, detalhista, organizado e com iniciativa.
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas contas e prazos remotamente.
  • Bilingue (inglês/português).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em marketing imobiliário ou marcas de serviços profissionais.
  • Habilidades em fotografia ou videomaker.
  • Conhecimento em Meta Ads ou estratégias pagas (não obrigatório, mas desejável).

How do you know if you have a disability?

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Alcohol or other substance use disorder (not currently using drugs illegally)

Global DBA Engineer

PURPOSE

APM Terminals, a global leader in port and terminal operations and part of the A.P. Moller-Maersk Group, is committed to delivering world-class container handling, logistics solutions, and maritime services. With operations in over 70 countries, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence, all while driving sustainable growth and making a positive impact on communities worldwide.

At APM Terminals, we offer exceptional opportunities for personal and professional development in a diverse and inclusive environment. Join us as we shape the future of global trade and redefine industry standards.

TheGlobal DBA Engineer (DBA) role is responsible for the performance, integrity, security, and availability of databases within the organization. The role encompasses both strategic and operational duties, including the efficient storage of data, maintaining access reliability, and protection against data loss or unauthorized access. The DBA will collaborate closely with terminal and regional infrastructure teams to uphold current standards, implement robust backup and recovery policies, and carry out database tuning and performance monitoring to support business continuity and system optimization.

Principle Accountabilities

  • We are looking for DBA with experience mainly in SQL-Server.
  • Install and maintain the performance of database servers.
  • Install and maintain HA scenarios AON, replication.
  • knowledge of database security, backup and recovery, and performance monitoring standards
  • Develop processes for optimizing database security.
  • Set and maintain database standards.
  • Manage database access.
  • Performance tuning of database systems.
  • Install, upgrade, and manage database applications.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot database errors.
  • Triage reported issues to accurately identify, escalate, and respond to urgent or critical matters in support of terminal operations.
  • Identify root causes of outages and issues and prepare plans for permanent changes to eliminate/reduce chronic issues or establish SOPs for resolution by ‘shift left’ resources
  • Recommend and implement emerging database technologies.
  • Create and manage database reports, visualizations, and dashboards.
  • Create automation for repeating database tasks.
  • Work with the Global N4 Migration Team on all N4 upgrades.
  • Document implementation & deployment plans
  • Be available for on-call support as needed.
  • Valuable Oracle DBA experience
  • In cooperation with TOS app, deliver 24x7x365 (follow the sun) support to end users and system consumers N4 and related applications.Expand support model to all locations globally.

The above outlined responsibilities are not exhaustive, and you may be required to carry out other tasks that are appropriate to your role in addition to these.

CRITICAL QUALIFICATIONS/SKILLS/EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field preferred
  • Over three years of experience in database administration, information technology, database architecture, or a related field
  • MCSE/MCSA certifications preferred
  • Experience with Windows Server environments preferred
  • Good communication skills
  • Fluent in English. Spanish is valuable.
  • Adaptable to different cultures.
  • Willingness and availability to travel.

title: Business Services Team Manager
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few roles based in offices.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring a Business Services Team Manager to lead efficient and effective travel, logistics, event, scheduling, expense policy and administration.

This executive role requires outstanding coordination, planning, decision-making, budgeting, procurement, reporting and management. It is a fast-paced and complex operation in the tech industry.

We coordinate large-scale company events which involve travel for hundreds of people from 80+ countries. We run such events four times a year, a significant investment in our ability to shape culture, teamwork, execution plans and strategy. Our team is responsible for travel procurement and logistics, ensuring that these events run efficiently and safely. Visas, travel complications and unexpected situations make this a complex operation to run efficiently, demanding a rigorous approach and high work ethic in the team.

This team also serves as an independent check on expense claim approval, ensuring fairness and consistency across teams and countries. This requires integrity, transparency and accountability, and a willingness to set and politely defend the same expectations of the most senior and most junior colleagues.

Together these responsibilities amount to tens of millions in operational costs and a significant number of tactical and operational decisions.

Our team also provides traditional 'EA' services for company leads, though they do this across departments and as a consistent service rather than as personal assistants; they set and deliver to expectations on specific kinds of work. They schedule meetings, coordinate monthly reports, handle delegated approvals for travel and expenses, work across teams, coordinate with suppliers, and run small projects or initiatives.

Location: Worldwide, home based, except in locations where we have an office, such as London, Taipei and Beijing

  • Travel approvals, logistics and operations
  • Expense review in line with policies
  • Planning of complex company events four times a year
  • Company offices that provide executive briefing and operational facilities
  • Our global duty of care, health and safety programs with comprehensive policies and practices

  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility
  • Responsibility, accountability, thoughtfulness and self-awareness
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Travel industry experience
  • Project management experience
  • Event management and operations experience
  • Business and corporate administration experience

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Recognition rewards

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. description:

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Associate Linux Support Engineer role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring an Associate Support Engineer to build a career with Canonical and support the technical needs of customers leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. This role is an opportunity for a hands-on engineer with eagerness to learn, a passion for Linux and open source technologies to work with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.
We regularly solve interesting, technical problems. From triaging complex cloud environments, desktop and server issues, Linux kernel crashes we've never seen before to OS configuration issues and root cause analysis, we provide an expert level of support and satisfaction to our peer groups and customers. You will be accountable for delivering an outstanding technical support experience on the full technical stack at Canonical, across cloud, desktop and IoT. From problem qualification to full resolution, you will own and manage your cases. When needed, you will transfer your cases to your colleagues or involve senior engineers. This is a globally remote role.
Location: This is a globally remote role.
The role entails

  • Working from your remote home office to provide technical support for employees.
  • Being available to take ownership of new cases via telephone, email and web
  • Acting as an internal customer advocate keeping them updated in a timely manner
  • Ensuring that each support case owned by you is handled according to our Service Level Agreement (SLA) with the highest possible customer satisfaction by setting the right expectations and fulfilling your commitments.
  • Contributing new knowledge base articles and maintaining existing articles, ensuring shared knowledge and lessons learned are available to customers.
  • Drafting and distributing technical notices for internal and external communication.
  • Prioritising your work in order to accomplish the most important and urgent tasks first
  • Keeping on learning as our products and services grow and evolve
  • Understanding Ubuntu development process to be able to set customer expectations correctly on timeline for a fix
  • Maintaining regular communication and information exchange with the rest of the team, locally and remotely
  • Identifying and suggesting any opportunities to provide a better service
  • Participating in a regular weekend working rotation
What we are looking for in you
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path. Preferable majors: Computer Science, MIS, Electrical Engineering, etc.
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Experience with Linux troubleshooting (collecting logs and stack traces, fine-tuning by editing configuration files)
  • Knowledge or basic hands-on experience on 2 or more of:
    • Linux server administration
    • Programming fundamentals in any language (bash, Perl, Ruby, Javascript, C or C++, Go)
    • Networking (bonding, firewalling, bridging, switching, network file system tuning, MTU issues, etc.)
    • Virtualization / Cloud computing concepts (provisioning, monitoring, orchestration, etc.)
  • Ability to learn quickly, thrive on change and handle the pressure of a customer facing job
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Noting that we require and will perform a background check for this role.
Nice-to-have skills
  • Experience supporting virtualized environments (KVM, Virtual Box, VMWare)
  • Experience with other open-source desktop technologies
  • Active contribution to open-source projects/forum/code
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

We are seeking an experienced and customer-focused Product Owner to join the Lending Squad at RecargaPay. In this role, you will take ownership of the end-to-end lifecycle of loan products - defining the vision, shaping the roadmap, and leading cross-functional execution. You'll partner with engineering, design and credit teams to deliver lending experiences that drive growth, improve user engagement, and enhance financial inclusion.

  • Lead Product Vision & Roadmap: Define and articulate a clear vision and strategy for loan products based on market needs, user feedback, and business objectives. Transform this vision into a structured roadmap with clear priorities and milestones

  • Monitor Product Performance & Impact: Define and track product success metrics. Partner with analytics and business teams to assess feature adoption, user behavior, and portfolio impact. Use insights to refine the roadmap and inform future decisions
Own Go-To-Market & Launch Plans: Coordinate product releases in alignment with internal stakeholders. Ensure clear communication, training materials, and support for successful product launches.

  • Agile Delivery Leadership: Strong experience leading Agile squads, managing backlogs, and delivering digital products in iterative cycles
  • Customer-Centric Mindset: Passion for solving real user problems with thoughtful, intuitive product solutions
  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to prioritize initiatives based on user value, technical feasibility, and business impact
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Excellent communication skills and the ability to align stakeholders across engineering, design, credit, and operations
  • Business Awareness: Understanding of credit products, loan lifecycle, and financial KPIs such as default rates, cost of acquisition, and portfolio health

Nice-to-Have Skills
  • Fintech or Credit Experience: Familiarity with consumer credit products, risk models, or digital lending operations

  • Experimentation Culture: Exposure to A/B testing, hypothesis-driven development, and iterative innovation

  • Process Optimization: Experience improving product delivery workflows, QA practices, and post-launch operations
Benefits

  • Health and dental plans with no co-pay

We value the richness of each journey and the multiple ways of seeing the world, without distinctions of gender, race, sexual orientation, age, religion, or any other characteristic that makes us unique.

Business Development Representative (BDR) – US Market Focus (Remote)

Are you a sharp, structured B2B sales professional who knows how to create pipeline from scratch and convert outbound outreach into real business? We’re hiring a remote Business Development Representative to help us scale high-quality lead generation and deal flow for digital-first clients targeting the US market.

This role is ideal for someone who understands the rhythm of outbound sales, has experience speaking with decision-makers, and thrives in a structured, performance-driven environment. You’ll be responsible for sourcing, engaging, and nurturing leads, and helping move them through the sales funnel in collaboration with our consultants and closers.

Core Focus Areas

  • 2+ years working with the US market, with cultural fluency and strong business awareness
  • Proven experience with outbound and inbound outreach—cold calling, email prospecting, LinkedIn outreach, and building lead lists
  • Hands-on experience using lead engagement tools—especially HubSpot CRM
  • Success in converting cold leads into discovery calls or qualified opportunities
  • Strong communication skills—confident in business-level discussions with stakeholders
  • Comfortable operating at the “middle layer” level—speaking to decision-makers, not just end users or C-suite

Competences

  • Degree in the field or related areas

Se você é uma pessoa interessada em trabalhar em uma equipe dinâmica e acelerada, aprendendo sobre novas e inovadoras ferramentas e no desenvolvimento contínuo de habilidades, esta é uma excelente oportunidade. Acreditamos que pequenas equipes de pessoas inteligentes e dedicadas, trabalhando com liberdade, domínio e propósito, podem alcançar coisas extraordinárias.

Estamos procurando um Engenheiro de QA para se juntar à nossa equipe de trabalho remoto.

Responsabilidades:

Criar e executar planos, estratégias e casos de teste abrangentes para aplicações Web e APIs REST, assegurando que requisitos funcionais e não funcionais sejam cobertos.

Desenvolver cenários de teste em BDD (Behavior Driven Development) para promover uma comunicação clara e eficaz entre as equipes de desenvolvimento, QA e stakeholders.

Assegurar ampla cobertura de testes, alinhando-os aos objetivos de negócio e às especificações técnicas para reduzir riscos e aumentar a qualidade do produto.

Conduzir testes funcionais, de performance e regressão, otimizando continuamente os pipelines de automação para entregas mais rápidas e confiáveis.

Configurar e gerenciar ambientes de teste, assegurando a consistência entre os ambientes de desenvolvimento, teste e produção.

Monitorar e integrar pipelines de CI/CD com testes automatizados, garantindo feedback rápido e contínuo sobre a qualidade do software.

Gerar e apresentar relatórios detalhados sobre resultados de testes, riscos identificados e métricas de qualidade para os stakeholders, facilitando a tomada de decisões estratégicas.

Atuar de forma proativa na identificação e mitigação de riscos em ambientes de produção, assegurando alta disponibilidade e confiabilidade dos sistemas.

Promover uma cultura de melhoria contínua em QA, revisando e aprimorando práticas, ferramentas e processos para aumentar a eficiência e a qualidade.

  • Adotar e disseminar as melhores práticas de testes automatizados entre as equipes de engenharia, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de soluções mais robustas e escaláveis.

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Proficiência em ferramentas como Playwright, Cypress ou Selenium WebDriver.
  • Forte conhecimento em automação de testes para APIs e aplicações web.
  • Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD (ex.: CircleCI, GitHub Actions).

Join to apply for the Software Maintenance Engineer role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Software Maintenance Engineer to…
…work in a dynamic and exciting engineering role in Linux-based infrastructure and applications, covering all layers of the stack, including bare metal, virtualization (KVM), containerization (Docker/LXC/LXD), storage (Ceph and Linux filesystems), networking (OVS, OVN and Core networking), OpenStack, Kubernetes and the open source applications running on top of them. It will challenge you to show the breadth of your engineering skills, which will be needed to work on almost any aspect of Ubuntu and the open source applications large enterprise customers run.
This role is an opportunity for a technologist with a passion for Linux and open source to build a career with Canonical and drive success for our customers, community and the company. If you have an affinity for open source software, great communication skills, and a passion for troubleshooting and fixing issues in technology used by millions across the world, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.
This role deals with critical issues in the open source stack that require upstream bug fixes. Our engineers are able to work productively at any level of the stack including the kernel and in a wide range of languages, to understand and address the software issues at hand. Our group is critical to the success of our customers, partners and Ubuntu itself.
You will help with troubleshooting and driving issues to resolution with workarounds, guidance, and bug fixes to be released upstream and in Ubuntu.
Location: This is a remote role, we have teams in all time zones.
The role entails

  • Resolve complex customer problems related to Ubuntu, Kernel, Ceph, OpenStack, or Kubernetes and other open source software
  • Maintain a close working relationship with Canonical's Field, Support and product engineering teams
  • Participate in upstream communities
  • Develop bug fixes, backport patches, and work with upstream for inclusion
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Demonstrate good judgment in technical methods and techniques
  • Prioritize work and manage your time effectively against those priorities
  • Participate in team discussions to improve processes, tools, and documentation
  • Maintain clear, technical and concise communications
  • Work from home and travel internationally up to 10% of work time for team meetings, events and conferences
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Background in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • Experience with Linux and open source software
  • Experience with at least one of Python, Go, C or C++ on Linux
  • A drive to learn unfamiliar technology and deep-dive difficult issues
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Nice-to-have skills
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have interest in, or willingness to learn about any of the following: Ubuntu Linux - kernel or userspace, Kubernetes, OpenStack, Ceph, QEMU/KVM, LXC/LXD,Postgresql, Mongo, Debian packaging, distributed systems
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

A BigDataCorp é a maior datatech da América Latina, e democratiza, desde 2013, o acesso aos dados, aumentando possibilidades e certezas em um mundo repleto de incertezas.

  • Security hardening and exploit mitigation
  • Third-party driver integration and distribution, such as graphics
  • Expanded driver support for bleeding-edge PC platforms

Location: We have home-based Kernel Teams in every timezone.

The role entails

  • Collaborate regularly and proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Learn from senior mentors to demystify the inner workings of the Linux kernel and how it is distributed
  • Work closely with external silicon, cloud, or hardware manufacturer delivery teams on bleeding-edge platforms

What we are looking for in you

  • Well-organized and motivated self-starter able to thrive in a remote work environment
  • Professional manner with colleagues, business partners, and the open-source community
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and verbal
  • Programming experience in C and/or Rust
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git
  • Understanding of operating system kernel fundamentals
  • Ability to travel twice a year for company events of up to two weeks length

Nice-to-have skills

  • Interest and experience in Rust
  • Python and Bash scripting ability
  • Prior experience with Ubuntu/Debian/Snap packaging
  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other low level system engineering

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Who we are

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company with 61,000+ employees, approximately 1000 laboratories across 61 countries, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate.

Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies.

The Team

Eurofins endeavours to develop all of our software applications in-house to service and support our numerous laboratories globally. With hundreds of thousands of clinical diagnostic tests performed every day, the laboratories of the Eurofins clinical diagnostic services business line strive to ensure that every patient, wherever he or she lives, has access to the most specialized and most innovative techniques for diagnosis, monitoring and therapeutic decisions. Such activities require extensive planning and organisation which can be augmented by the use of technology.

Our Clinical LIMS Europe Program will extensively be used as the central Laboratory Information Management System throughout Europe, this role is crucial in defining and delivering the product roadmap.

Job Focus

In the role, you will work with a dedicated, enthusiastic team developing enhancements to a Laboratory Information Management System (a LIMS) and supporting the LIMS' multiple customers. This position supports Brazil-based operations and the Europe LIMS program as described above.

Responsibilities

  • Estimate the complexity and the workload
  • Choose the most appropriate technical solution to meet the user requirements
  • Design, develop and deploy changes to the LIMS according to the customers’ and business users’ requirements
  • Support the LIMS in collaboration with other team members
  • Work together with other team members (Engineers/QA) to ensure high quality of delivered solutions
  • Ensure good practices and high quality standards are implemented and followed

Experience / Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience developing solutions using Embarcadero Delphi 2006 or later (Delphi 12 preferable)
  • Experience with using Delphi to develop Windows Services and/or UI Forms is a bonus
  • 2+ years of experience with Oracle PL/SQL
  • Strong working knowledge on server-side development with Delphi and/or with Oracle PL/SQL
  • Strong analytical, problem solving and troubleshooting skills
  • Good understanding of relational databases (Oracle 9i, 11c or later)
  • Strong knowledge of Agile software development practices, particularly Scrum and/or Kanban
  • Clear experience in collaboration with Business Analysts and Software Architect(s)
  • Some experience in test driven development and test automation
  • Comfortable in unit testing and mocking with Delphi
  • Ability to translate functional requirements into technical solutions

Education

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or similar

What else should I know?

As the role and Eurofins' IT Talent Acquisition team are international, please ensure to submit your application in English.

title: Analista de Dados Pleno
description:
Somos uma empresa em crescimento no setor de EdTech, focada em transformar a educação por meio de tecnologia e inovação. Nosso propósito é ajudar estudantes de todo o Brasil a alcançar seus objetivos educacionais, e estamos em busca de profissionais talentosos e apaixonados para se juntar à nossa equipe.

Cargo: Analista de Dados Pleno

Missão do cargo: Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados Pleno com perfil analítico, boa capacidade de comunicação e domínio técnico para atuar na transformação de dados em insights estratégicos. Essa pessoa terá papel essencial no apoio à tomada de decisões em diferentes frentes da empresa, colaborando com times de produto, marketing, pedagógico e tecnologia.

Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar análises exploratórias e descritivas com foco em geração de insights para o negócio;
  • Coletar, limpar, transformar e organizar dados provenientes de diferentes fontes. Construir relatórios e dashboards claros e acionáveis, alinhados às necessidades das áreas;
  • Apoiar stakeholders na interpretação de dados e na tomada de decisão orientada por evidências;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com os times de produto, tecnologia e marketing para identificar oportunidades de melhoria com base em dados;
  • Participar de projetos estratégicos da empresa que envolvam análise de dados e acompanhamento de métricas;
  • Desenvolver, automatizar e manter pipelines de ETLs para garantir a disponibilidade, integridade e atualização contínua dos dados utilizados pelas áreas de negócio.

Requisitos :

  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística, Matemática, Física ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia como analista de dados, com histórico de atuação em ambientes orientados por dados;
  • Conhecimento sólido em SQL para consulta e manipulação de dados;
  • Domínio de Python aplicado à análise de dados e habilidade com uso de bibliotecas, tais como Pandas e Numpy;
  • Conhecimento de estatística descritiva e capacidade de interpretar métricas, tendências e padrões;
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais e conceitos de arquitetura de dados;
  • Habilidade na construção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando ferramentas de BI (Looker Studio e Metabase);
  • Capacidade analítica apurada, com raciocínio lógico estruturado e foco em resolução de problemas;
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com facilidade para traduzir dados em informações acionáveis para diferentes áreas da empresa.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com bases de dados não relacionais (ex: MongoDB);
  • Participação em projetos de dados (profissionais ou pessoais) com entrega de análises relevantes;
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados e visualizações interativas;
  • Familiaridade com processos de coleta e integração de dados a partir de múltiplas fontes (APIs, planilhas, bancos externos, etc.).

Detalhes sobre a vaga:

  • E um ambiente cheio de gente do bem e com muita vontade de entregar resultados!
